snapshotAuthorities.title: Canonical Admin Analytics metric snapshots
snapshotAuthorities.freshnessRule: Admin display sources must carry live, verified_cache, stale_cache, estimated, fallback, unavailable, or debug_only labels and must not show zero without source sample evidence.
snapshotAuthorities.recommendedAction: Make this the canonical compact Admin Analytics display snapshot layer for module display truth.

snapshotAuthorities.title: Legacy realtime summary aggregate
snapshotAuthorities.freshnessRule: May support live-pulse or fallback evidence only when labeled and demoted behind analytics_admin_metric_snapshots.
snapshotAuthorities.recommendedAction: Demote behind analytics_admin_metric_snapshots for Admin Analytics module truth; keep as labeled fallback/evidence only.

snapshotAuthorities.title: Raw analytics ledger collections
snapshotAuthorities.freshnessRule: Raw collections are materializer inputs and Debug evidence; bounded fallback requires source labels and fake-zero protection.
snapshotAuthorities.recommendedAction: Keep raw collections out of compact Admin Analytics display truth and route details through Admin Debug or snapshot materializers.

snapshotAuthorities.title: GA4/PostHog/BigQuery vendor evidence lanes
snapshotAuthorities.freshnessRule: Vendor values must be labeled estimated, export_only, or debug_parity and must never override first-party snapshot truth.
snapshotAuthorities.recommendedAction: Use vendor lanes for estimates, export evidence, and Debug parity only.

adminDisplayRules.recommendedAction: Admin Analytics should stay compact and snapshot-first, with Debug links for formulas and source detail.

allowedSources: bounded fallback with labels and fake-zero protection
adminDisplayRules.recommendedAction: Replace raw display fallbacks in later runtime phases with verified snapshots or Debug-only evidence.
A zero value is displayable only after the source denominator or sample evidence is known.
Vendor comparison may explain drift but must not replace first-party snapshot truth.

adminDebugRules.recoveryUse: Admin Debug is the first surface for recovered analytics evidence before compact Admin Analytics promotion.
adminDebugRules.recommendedAction: Surface recovered data details in Debug with blockers and confidence before any Admin Analytics rollup.

adminDebugRules.recoveryUse: Debug explains why compact Admin Analytics values are live, stale, unavailable, estimated, or fallback.
adminDebugRules.recommendedAction: Keep formulas, source counts, drift, and cost warnings in Debug rather than expanding Admin Analytics cards.

adminDebugRules.recoveryUse: Debug should retain the detailed reason a lane is demoted, costly, stale, or not yet eligible for display.
adminDebugRules.recommendedAction: Route cost and authority drift to Debug until a runtime simplification patch removes the underlying pattern.

vendorBoundaries.recommendedAction: Use GA4 for directional evidence and Debug parity only; intraday/realtime values must stay labeled.

vendorBoundaries.forbiddenRole: product truth override or readiness dependency
vendorBoundaries.recommendedAction: Keep PostHog as optional vendor evidence and do not make readiness depend on live PostHog data.

vendorBoundaries.forbiddenRole: runtime/Admin Analytics display truth or broad scan cost control by LIMIT
vendorBoundaries.recommendedAction: Keep BigQuery as export/evidence; no runtime display path should query it or claim LIMIT controls raw scan cost.

costSimplificationCandidates.title: Admin realtime listeners over raw analytics collections
costSimplificationCandidates.currentPattern: Admin display or hooks can observe raw analytics collections directly.
costSimplificationCandidates.preferredPattern: Snapshot-first Admin Analytics with raw collection detail routed to Admin Debug.
costSimplificationCandidates.recommendedAction: Replace direct display listeners with verified snapshot reads in a later runtime simplification pass.

costSimplificationCandidates.title: Admin routes reading raw guest/event/watch collections as display fallback
costSimplificationCandidates.currentPattern: Admin routes may query raw collections when snapshot evidence is missing.
costSimplificationCandidates.preferredPattern: Unavailable/stale/needs_review state unless a bounded labeled fallback already exists.
costSimplificationCandidates.recommendedAction: Collapse raw route fallbacks behind analytics_admin_metric_snapshots and Debug-only source evidence.

costSimplificationCandidates.title: Duplicate snapshot authority between realtime summary and admin metric snapshots
costSimplificationCandidates.currentPattern: analytics_aggregate_stats/realtime_summary and analytics_admin_metric_snapshots both look like display authorities.
costSimplificationCandidates.preferredPattern: analytics_admin_metric_snapshots is canonical; realtime_summary is fallback/live-pulse/evidence only.
costSimplificationCandidates.recommendedAction: Make Admin Analytics modules read the canonical snapshot layer and demote realtime_summary in labels/docs.

costSimplificationCandidates.title: Vendor-derived guest estimates without source/confidence labels
costSimplificationCandidates.currentPattern: GA/PostHog/BigQuery evidence can be blended into user-facing operator counts.
costSimplificationCandidates.preferredPattern: First-party snapshots win; vendor values are labeled estimated/debug parity.
costSimplificationCandidates.recommendedAction: Require source/confidence labels and prevent vendor estimates from overriding first-party snapshots.

costSimplificationCandidates.title: Stale generated reports used as authority
costSimplificationCandidates.currentPattern: Generated reports older than 24 hours can look authoritative in docs or Debug evidence.
costSimplificationCandidates.preferredPattern: Generated reports are snapshots and stale after 24 hours unless an explicit contract says otherwise.
costSimplificationCandidates.recommendedAction: Keep generated reports labeled as evidence snapshots and rerun validators before using them as inputs.

costSimplificationCandidates.title: Watch/session metrics duplicating page duration or event counts
costSimplificationCandidates.currentPattern: Watch truth can drift if page duration or event counts are treated as canonical.
costSimplificationCandidates.preferredPattern: Watch-session rollups are canonical; legacy page duration is fallback/legacy evidence only.
costSimplificationCandidates.recommendedAction: Keep watch/session display behind rollups and label page duration as legacy fallback where used.

costSimplificationCandidates.title: Support/recovery facts stay raw-only and invisible
costSimplificationCandidates.currentPattern: Support recovery evidence may be written but not surfaced in operator Debug recovery views.
costSimplificationCandidates.preferredPattern: Debug-first support/recovery evidence with labels before any compact Admin Analytics rollup.
costSimplificationCandidates.recommendedAction: Plan a Debug-first surfacing pass that keeps support/recovery facts operational, not behavioral personalization.

costSimplificationCandidates.title: Notification delivery/read facts split across raw paths
costSimplificationCandidates.currentPattern: Notification delivery, read, and engagement evidence can stay split across raw lanes.
costSimplificationCandidates.preferredPattern: Debug-first delivery/read source labels before optional Admin Analytics aggregate surfacing.
costSimplificationCandidates.recommendedAction: Unify notification evidence through labeled Debug parity before promoting aggregate health metrics.

issues.title: Duplicate snapshot authority collapse partially landed for realtime and historical routes
issues.description: Realtime and historical Admin Analytics routes now prefer analytics_admin_metric_snapshots and demote legacy/raw sources; broader materializer/module cleanup remains.
issues.recommendedAction: Keep analytics_admin_metric_snapshots canonical, then collapse remaining module/materializer authority conflicts in later runtime passes.

issues.title: Raw display fallback collapse partially landed for realtime and historical routes
issues.description: Realtime and historical compact display paths no longer rebuild display truth from raw analytics logs when verified snapshots are unavailable; Debug/raw recovery surfacing remains future work.
issues.recommendedAction: Audit remaining Admin Analytics modules and Debug recovery lanes for any raw display fallbacks outside the realtime/historical route arteries.

issues.title: Vendor/source labeling partially landed at module level
issues.description: Realtime and historical route authority checks now block vendor override in compact display paths, and Admin Analytics modules label vendor evidence, verified snapshots, raw Debug-only evidence, and recovery review-only state. Broader cost and materializer simplification remains future work.
issues.recommendedAction: Keep vendor labels locked while the next cost simplification runtime pass removes remaining duplicate/raw materializer cost risks.

issues.title: Admin Debug recovery evidence surfacing partially landed
issues.description: Admin Debug now exposes Phase 3 recovery lanes with source, confidence, consent, blocker, productionAllowedNow=false, and no Admin Analytics promotion metadata. A later pass still needs module-level review before any compact Admin Analytics promotion.
issues.recommendedAction: Use the Debug recovery evidence payload to drive the next module-level vendor/source label and recovery promotion review.

issues.title: Cost simplification needs a separate runtime pass
issues.description: This static contract identifies cost-risk patterns but does not remove raw reads, listeners, duplicate materializers, or broad fallback work.
issues.recommendedAction: Use the costSimplificationCandidates list as the scope for the next runtime simplification prompt.
